plainText:
The Wild Full-Power Pose of Fire (Japanese: 乱舞！！炎のゼンリョクでポーズ！ Dance!! The Full-Powered Fire Pose!) is the 12th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
 
Lana and Mallow stay back to fight the s while , , and Kiawe head to the Ruins of Life to protect .
Kiawe teaches Sun how to perform the Z-Move .
Gladion is revealed to be Kiawe's attacker and has managed to capture .
Kiawe tries to lend his Z-Ring to Sun, but it is destroyed by Gladion's .
Kahili appears and delivers Sun his Z-Ring that was created by Hala.
With the Z-Ring, Sun and activate Inferno Overdrive.
